subject: AWS Marketplace listing readiness + co-sell demo guides
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Mark Collins <mcollins@techpartners.io>, aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing readiness + co-sell demo guides

Hi Mark / AWS Marketplace team,

Thanks for the quick kickoff last week. We pulled together an initial checklist and a set of sample product-page copy snippets that the field (and co-sell teams) can use during buyer conversations. At a high level we need to lock in: 

- AMI visibility / seller-account mapping (required for private offers)
- SKU & pricing footnotes (metering & trial language)
- Hero one-liner + 3 usage scenarios for the product page
- Field demo script (3–4 minute demo + 1-slide value prop)
- Evidence pack for co-sell (SOC2 artifacts, data flow diagram)

I attached a draft: marketplace_snippets_v2.docx and a quick demo-slate PNG to illustrate the one-slide. Can you confirm owners for the AMI mapping and the compliance evidence? Target timeline is to be listing-ready for co-sell enablement by 2026-12-15.

Next steps I propose:
1) AWS confirms AMI / Private Offer requirements and any marketplace-only footnotes by 12/04
2) TechPartners confirms field demo acceptance criteria by 12/08
3) Redwood finalizes hero/usage copy + attachments by 12/10

Attachments: marketplace_snippets_v2.docx (docx), demo-slate.png (png)

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Mark Collins <mcollins@techpartners.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, aws-marketplace-team@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 13:15:12 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing readiness + co-sell demo guides

Thanks Sergio — this looks good and actionable. A couple quick items from our side: 

- I attached our compliance summary (partner-compliance.pdf). It lists the SOC2 and data controls we expect buyers to ask about.
- For pricing footnotes: we need to clarify trial enforcement and metering window (hourly vs. per-minute). Can Redwood provide the suggested wording we prefer on the product page?
- For the demo, can the field script include an explicit failover/latency slide and a one-minute cost math example? Our field folks ask for that up front.

We can confirm AMI mapping but we need the AWS Marketplace team to confirm whether the SellerID will be visible in the private-offer workflow (that affects how we present the AMI).

Happy to take the lead on demo acceptance criteria — target 12/08 is fine.

Thanks — I pulled the draft into a quick QC pass. High-level notes: 

- Hero one-liner (option A): "Predictable, low-latency LLM inference for production apps."
- Usage scenarios (short bullets for product page):
  1) Real-time conversational agents (sub-second median latency)
  2) Batch embedding pipelines (throughput & cost controls)
  3) Private deployment for regulated data (VPC & KMS support)

- Pricing footnote suggestion: "Usage is metered per 1,000 tokens; trial credits expire after 30 days unless otherwise noted." We should confirm with AWS on whether the product page supports the per-1k token phrasing or requires hourly compute language.

I attached an AMI visibility checklist (ami-visibility-checklist.xlsx) with the mapping steps we use for Private Offers. Owner for the AMI mapping step: Technical Ops (assign to Javier at TechPartners).

Attachment: ami-visibility-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Looping in a couple of seller/field bits — thanks for drafting, Sergio. Quick deliverables from our enablement side: 

- Field demo script (3 phases):
  1) 60s value prop + architecture slide (what runs where)
  2) 120s live demo: inference request -> token billing example (cost math)
  3) 30s closing: deployment options + next steps for trial

- Seller playbook (link): https://drive.google.com/rdw-playbooks/marketplace-seller-playbook (field facing)
- Demo acceptance checklist (link): https://drive.google.com/rdw-playbooks/demo-acceptance

I suggest we schedule a 30-minute co-sell pre-brief with the AWS team. Proposed slot: Thu 2026-12-09 10:00 PT — calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=aws-cosell-prebrief-20261209

- Jonas: can you lead the AWS co-sell pre-brief on 12/09 and own the field agenda?

I've added the HubSpot deal and DocuSign Private Offer link to the thread for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RDW-APL-2026-0423 and https://www.docusign.com/rooms/ABC-PrivateOffer-2026
